# PocketBase

> PocketBase is an open source backend consisting of embedded database (SQLite) with realtime subscriptions, built-in auth management, convenient dashboard UI and simple REST-ish API. It can be used as a standalone app or as a Go/JS framework library.

## Overview

- [Introduction](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/): Core concepts and getting started with PocketBase.
- [Collections](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/collections/): Defining and managing database collections.
- [API rules and filters](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/api-rules-and-filters/): Security rules and filter expressions for data access control.
- [Client-side SDKs](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/client-side-sdks/): Official SDKs for JavaScript, Dart, and other languages.
- [Authentication](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/authentication/): User authentication with multiple providers.
- [Files upload and handling](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/files-handling/): Managing file uploads, storage, and retrieval.
- [Working with relations](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/working-with-relations/): Creating and managing relationships between collections.
- [Use as framework](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/use-as-framework/): Embedding PocketBase as a Go or JavaScript framework.
- [Going to production](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/going-to-production/): Deployment and production considerations.

## API Reference

- [Web APIs reference](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/api-records/): Overview of available REST API endpoints.
- [API Records](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/api-records/): CRUD operations for collection records.
- [API Realtime](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/api-realtime/): WebSocket-based realtime subscriptions.
- [API Files](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/api-files/): File download and access endpoints.
- [API Admins](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/api-admins/): Admin authentication and management.
- [API Collections](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/api-collections/): Collection schema management.
- [API Settings](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/api-settings/): Application settings management.
- [API Logs](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/api-logs/): Request logs and statistics.
- [API Backups](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/api-backups/): Database backup operations.
- [API Health](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/api-health/): Health check endpoint.

## Go Extensions

- [Go Overview](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-overview/): Introduction to extending PocketBase with Go.
- [Go Event hooks](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-event-hooks/): Event-driven hooks for customizing behavior.
- [Go Routing](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-routing/): Custom route registration and handling.
- [Go Database](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-database/): Direct database access and queries.
- [Go Record operations](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-records/): Programmatic record manipulation.
- [Go Collection operations](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-collections/): Managing collections programmatically.
- [Go Migrations](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-migrations/): Database schema migrations.
- [Go Jobs scheduling](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-jobs-scheduling/): Background job scheduling.
- [Go Console commands](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-console-commands/): Custom CLI commands.
- [Go Sending emails](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-sending-emails/): Email sending functionality.
- [Go Rendering templates](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-rendering-templates/): Server-side template rendering.
- [Go Logging](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-logging/): Custom logging and log hooks.
- [Go Testing](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-testing/): Testing utilities and strategies.
- [Go Custom models](https://pocketbase.io/old/docs/go-custom-models/): Defining custom data models.
